newsitem.title: USA: Scitex stake held by Franklin.
newsitem.headline: Scitex stake held by Franklin.

text.p: A group led by Franklin Resources Inc said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing released on February 13 it holds a six percent stake in Scitex Corp Ltd or 2,554,450 common shares.
The group disclosed its initial position on Scitex in a 13G filing.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.
Israel-based Scitex has U.S. headquarters in Bedford, Mass. Scitex makes visual information communication products for the graphics arts, digital-printing and digital video markets.
